purpose: Source-screening record for the sun-side horizon/zenith independent-measurement probe (plan Step 1). Answers plan gate G0: does at least one public original measurement satisfy the pre-registered admission contract?

main_adjudication_requires: original paper (not second-hand, not model-generated data)
daytime clear sky: solar elevation > 0 deg, clear stated in the original
sun-side direction: |relative azimuth to sun| <= 5 deg
view elevation within [0 deg, 5 deg] (near-horizon points used at their actual direction/FOV, never extrapolated to 0 deg)
zenith measured in the same scan
same-field turbidity/AOD (Linke T, AOD, or Angstrom with stated convention)
photopic-comparable quantity: V(lambda)-weighted luminance or full-visible-band spectral radiance convertible to photopic Y (narrow-band ratios are auxiliary only)

reference-side independence from the CIE 110-1994 fitting corpus, with recorded basis (new acquisition later than the curve's finalisation and not reusing historical scans; publication date alone is insufficient)
admission_contract.g0: at least 1 qualified independent scan; |ln(M/C)| >= ln(1.5) stable over the allowed uncertainty set; observed-error half-width u <= ln(1.2) and |ln(M/C)| >= 3u; unknown error does not default to pass
admission_contract.abcu: A/B/C/U branches and multi-scan aggregation as pre-registered in the task plan section 3.3 (frozen before any model run); with 0 qualified sources the verdict is U (inadjudicable) and no attribution computation is performed
admission_contract.provenance: constants transcribed from the reviewed task plan (scratchpad/task-horizon-ref-probe/plan.md sections 3.1/3.3, plan status: confirmed); no numeric threshold was changed at implementation time

verdict.action: screening table and domain-gap statement persisted here and escalated; no matched model runs, no A/B/C verdict, no attribution claim

reference_side_independence.note: CIE 110-1994 standard clear sky is the Kittler-type parameterisation (gradation coefficient 0.32; indicatrix 0.91 + 10 exp(-3 gamma) + 0.45 cos^2 gamma). Its fitting corpus is the 1950s-1980s European daylighting luminance-scan lineage, which conventionally does not include near-horizon points. Any pre-1994 European daylighting scan is therefore treated as independence-unknown; an acquisition later than 1994 that is newly collected and does not reuse historical scans (e.g. Granada 1998) has a defensible independence basis. The CIE 110-1994 original itself is paywalled (recorded in RULER_AUDIT.md 3d), so the complete fitting-corpus list cannot be verified; this residual does not affect the 0-qualified-sources conclusion.

costs.retrieval_actions: 13 web searches, 6 full-text acquisitions (PDF/HTML), 2 figure-plate visual verifications
costs.stop_reason: budget exhausted with 0 qualified sources; stop-loss per plan

domain_gap.statement: Within the screened budget no public original measurement combines (i) a sun-side near-horizon direction (relative azimuth <= 5 deg, view elevation within [0,5] deg), (ii) the zenith in the same scan, (iii) same-field measured turbidity/AOD, and (iv) photopic or full-visible-spectral coverage. The geometrically closest campaign (Granada 2001) fails only the turbidity gate and publishes no numeric luminance table; daylighting-lineage scans conventionally stop ~6 deg above the horizon; atmospheric-optics campaigns favour the anti-solar principal plane; coronagraphic/site surveys sample sun-relative distances without zenith.

commission/locate a directional sky scan with concurrent AOD at a site with unobstructed horizon (owner decision)
re-run this probe if such a source becomes available; the admission contract in this file is the frozen gate
